# @canopy/rest

Canopy Data API: the DLS enforced REST endpoints and the transactional write path shared with realtime mutations.

Most apps get it through `@canopy/server`. On its own, it is a fetch handler for find, count, distinct, aggregate, batch, insert, patch, replace and delete.

Part of [Canopy](https://github.com/FlazexHQ/Canopy), an open source, self hostable backend platform for MongoDB. Nothing is
published to npm yet: until then, use it from a clone of the repository.

## Install

```bash
bun add @canopy/rest @canopy/auth @canopy/policy mongodb
```

`pnpm add`, `yarn add` and `npm install` take the same names.

## Use

```ts
import { createServer } from "node:http"
import { Authenticator } from "@canopy/auth"
import { allow, auth, collection, createPolicySet, PolicyEngine } from "@canopy/policy"
import { createRestHandler, toNodeListener } from "@canopy/rest"
import { MongoClient } from "mongodb"

const todos = collection("todos", {
  exposed: true,
  policies: [allow.read("authenticated").where({ ownerId: auth("sub") })],
})
const rest = createRestHandler({
  client: new MongoClient(process.env.MONGODB_URI ?? ""),
  database: "app",
  metaDatabase: "canopy",
  policies: new PolicyEngine(createPolicySet([todos])),
  authenticator: new Authenticator(
    { jwksUrl: "https://YOUR_TENANT.auth0.com/.well-known/jwks.json", issuer: "https://YOUR_TENANT.auth0.com/" },
    { publishable: ["pk_app"] },
  ),
})
createServer(toNodeListener(rest)).listen(8080)
```
